capabilityCorrection.why: USER OBSERVATION, not a measurement. Codex measured it under the widened prompt (96326905), saw the reduction and declined to call it absence: "visibly reduces a population to two highlighted survivors and remains a manual coding flag under the repaired definition". They flagged it for a human rather than deciding, which was right. The user ruled yes. The record's own asserts supports it: "Plotted items DROP along vertical axes over time, isolating the few that remain elevated" — items leaving and not being replaced, which is the second form the widened definition admits. Beat 30a needs Jay-Z's absence to read as a gap, not a zero.
